name: Nationalist Fervor Doctrine
unlock_condition: Reach Nationalist (Milliyetçilik) Overall >= 40 through rally speeches emphasizing national sovereignty, domestic industry, and border security.
effect: Grants +15% starting crowd enthusiasm in nationalist-leaning districts and +10% armor for Bodyguard (Koruma) units.
donation_bonus: +12% donation multiplier from Nationalist voter blocs during city rallies.
combat_or_rally_bonus: +10% Bodyguard armor and +15% initial crowd cheer resistance against verbal sabotage.
description: Ideological progression threshold for Nationalist identity. Serves as an RTS doctrine upgrade unlocked organically through speech consistency rather than spending party budget.

name: Liberal Media Network
unlock_condition: Reach Liberal (Liberalizm) Overall >= 40 through speeches emphasizing free enterprise, individual rights, and trade openness.
effect: Unlocks +15% Propagandist persuasion range and boosts donation conversion in commercial hubs like Limankent.
donation_bonus: +18% donation propensity bonus from Liberal demographic groups.
combat_or_rally_bonus: +15% Propagandist (Propagandacı) effective outreach range and +10% persuasion impact in commercial cities.
description: Ideological progression threshold for Liberal identity. Amplifies media reach, Propagandist efficiency, and private-sector campaign donations without draining the Election Night treasury.

name: Democrat Grassroots Coalition
unlock_condition: Reach Democrat (Demokratlık) Overall >= 40 through speeches emphasizing civic participation, institutional checks, and social consensus.
effect: Expands Campaign Volunteer deployment cap by +1 per round and stabilizes crowd mood recovery after heckling.
donation_bonus: +10% steady coalition donation bonus across ideologically balanced cities such as Yeşilova.
combat_or_rally_bonus: +1 Campaign Volunteer (Kampanya Gönüllüsü) deployment limit per preparation phase and +12% crowd recovery from boos.
description: Ideological progression threshold for Democrat identity. Strengthens broad-tent grassroots mobilization and stabilizes rallies in mixed-ideology battleground cities.

name: Communist Union Mobilization
unlock_condition: Reach Communist (Komünizm) Overall >= 40 through speeches emphasizing labor solidarity, collective welfare, and public ownership.
effect: Increases Campaign Volunteer health by +15% and boosts organized turnout resistance in industrial hubs such as Demirkent.
donation_bonus: +15% collective small-donor contribution scaling from Communist voter blocs.
combat_or_rally_bonus: +15% Campaign Volunteer health and +15% protest resistance against opponent sabotage in working-class zones.
description: Ideological progression threshold for Communist identity. Turns grassroots labor networks into durable street presence and reliable collective rally donations.

name: Imperialist Patronage Machine
unlock_condition: Reach Imperialist (Emperyalizm) Overall >= 40 through speeches emphasizing geopolitical projection, mega-infrastructure, and centralized authority.
effect: Boosts elite patronage donations by +20% and applies a 1.20x bribery efficiency multiplier on the Election Night diminishing-returns curve (half_saturation = 6000, still strictly capped at 2 percentage points).
donation_bonus: +20% elite-patronage donation scale factor in major hubs like Başkent.
combat_or_rally_bonus: +10% Saboteur verbal pressure and 1.20x Election Night bribe efficiency (half_saturation = 6000) within the hard 2% max vote-swing cap.
description: Ideological progression threshold for Imperialist identity. Maximizes high-roller fundraising during rallies to finance decisive Election Night swing allocations.
